instructions: This file supplies only season constants. It is not a complete constructor tuple or executable deployment payload. Derive all unresolved addresses from the final four factory addresses and their documented CREATE nonces; encode the complete flat 14-field Configuration, hash the exact compiled creation code plus that tuple, then mine the hook CREATE2 salt. Review all service and authority settings separately. Follow docs/IMD_CONSTRUCTOR_DEPLOYMENT.md. Do not use the previous six-argument constructor or its old full initcode hash. The community treasury is a separate user-authorized local wallet, not an independent governance body. The reviewed V2 receiver remains unresolved (null), not a launch address. Before creating the hook, commit a reviewed nonzero V2 receiver address; no arbitrary post-finale receiver selection is allowed. The hook constructor rejects a V2 receiver equal to the owner, team treasury or community treasury, and neither the community treasury nor the V2 receiver can ever become owner. These child inputs are not needed for the four owner-only factory constructors.
